text:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Technical Data:
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdallah Elsayed M, tested at 08 Dec 2003, revised by EDEPCo. 
quality control eng. Adel Abdel Kader EL-Nagar, accepted by eng El Sayed 
Attiah; General Director, approved by eng. Awad Soliman; Head Sector of Talkha 
PS and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC Inspection and quality 
Control Head Sector.
Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear appropriate safety 
equipment as safety shoes, safety Helmet, breathing mask.
The charger must be out of 
service.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear appropriate safety 
equipment as safety shoes, safety Helmet, breathing mask.
The charger must be out of 
service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multimeter ( AVO METER )
Screw driver, Blower or vacuum cleaner.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the charger out put voltage.
Check the charger over voltage alarm.
Check the charger under voltage alarm.
Check the tightness of connections.
Clean cubicle ventilation grid.
Place the battery charger back into normal operating condition.
